name: Name
section_hint: A stretch of the timeline with rules on where playback goes from it. Drag or trim its block on the Sections lane; sections do not overlap.
before_hint: Checked as playback enters the section at its start. The first rule whose condition holds decides: skip the section or jump to an event. With none, the section plays.
after_hint: Checked as playback reaches the end of the section. The first rule whose condition holds decides: repeat the section or jump to an event. With none, playback goes on.
condition_hint: An expression in the file's language; an empty one always holds. A montage asks it on the server, of the entity it plays on; an effect asks it on the client, of the data of its handle.
preview_data_hint: What the preview plays with in place of an entity or a handle: assignments such as d.waiting = true; d.hp = 12; Conditions of sections read them as d. at once; the button sets them as written and starts the preview over.
preview_reset: Start the preview over with its data
